CommunityApplications.Profile:
Cache -> Array Share Control changes only the user shares you select to a chosen primary pool (normally cache), secondary storage Array, and Mover action Pool -> Array, using Unraid's native share-update interface. It creates a timestamped backup before every batch, verifies every applied change, and can restore the most recent un-restored batch. This repository contains the single Cache -> Array Share Control plugin.
Support and bug reports: https://github.com/RayMunro/unraid-cache-array-share/issues
